ASSET_CREDITS.md

# Original artwork and visual research

Created and Designed by Shahd Mohamed

All 26 PNG assets in asset-manifest.json are original integer-grid drawings produced for this game by tools/art.py. Each exists locally and is loaded by the game or its install manifest. There are sixteen 192×640 transparent character atlases, seven 480×270 environment plates, one prop atlas, and two application icons. No character or background from another game is included.

The character atlases use 48×80 frames with pivot [24,76]. Rows: idle, talk, walk, reach, fear, pain, transform, echo. Each row contains four frames. Timings and looping semantics are in assets/characters/animations.json. Runtime state selection is in src/render.js. Not every row is triggered for every character; rows describe available states, not a claim that every combination is a story event.

Research consulted on 2026-10-10 (references only; no assets copied):

- Lucas Pope, mobile document handling: https://dukope.com/devlogs/papers-please/mobile/ — preserve comparison and decisions; provide readable layouts and task-specific manipulation.
- INMOST official site: https://inmostgame.com/ — interconnected perspectives, environmental decay and emotional pacing.
- Motion Twin animation interview: https://www.nintendolife.com/news/2018/05/feature_reanimating_the_roguelike_with_dead_cells_developer_motiontwin — readable poses and motion. This project's assets are 2D drawings, not Motion Twin's 3D pipeline.
- Lospec cluster tutorials: https://lospec.com/pixel-art-tutorials/tags/clusters — deliberate connected pixel shapes and controlled texture.
- MDN Pointer Events: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Pointer_events/Using_Pointer_Events — unified mouse/pen/touch lifecycle.

Pixel geometry remains sharp; the renderer applies low-intensity light halos separately. The palette uses deep blue-green shadows, aged paper, amber task lighting, desaturated skin ramps and sparse crimson. The Arabic font is served locally.

Noto Sans Arabic is included unmodified from the Google Fonts / Noto project under SIL Open Font License 1.1. Copyright 2022 The Noto Project Authors. Acquired 2026-10-10 from https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/notosansarabic . Its full license is retained in licenses/NotoSansArabic-OFL.txt. This font is excluded from the game's proprietary license. Capacitor Core and App runtime code retain their MIT notices in licenses/.

AUDIO_CREDITS.md

# Audio credits

12 recordings were acquired from Kenney's Impact Sounds pack on 2026-10-10 and integrated locally. Creator: Kenney. Individual pack page: https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds . License stated on that page and in the acquired archive: CC0. The archive's exact license is retained in licenses/Kenney-Impact-Sounds.txt. The manifest records original source, local path and use. The recordings were converted to mono 22050 Hz PCM WAV with FFmpeg to use a common browser format, including older iOS WebViews.

Mappings: impactWood_medium → wood; impactMetal_light → metal; impactSoft_medium → paper/contact; footstep_concrete → step; impactGlass_light → glass; impactWood_heavy → stamp. Variants 000 and 001 are supplied for each. Soft impacts approximate paper contact; they are not described as recordings of paper rustling.

Seven WAV assets (rain, hum, echo, printer, phone, breath, music) are original seeded-noise and harmonic sound design generated by tools/art.py. They are synthesized beds and cues, not field recordings or human performances. Copyright © 2026 Shahd Mohamed. All rights reserved for these original compositions, subject to applicable law.

All 19 local assets are loaded by src/audio.js. Playback uses category gain, contextual loops, stereo positioning, door-dependent low-pass filtering, impact thresholds and per-event cooldowns. Important cues have text alternatives. Assets are listed in audio-manifest.json and included in the production offline cache. No proprietary audio was taken from the visual-reference games.

Privacy / الخصوصية

Privacy policy

Effective 10 October 2026. Created and Designed by Shahd Mohamed.

This game has no accounts, advertising, general tracking analytics, remote AI, or crash-reporting service. It offers an optional ending poll. No ending choice is sent to Supabase unless you explicitly opt in on the ending screen and press Share. If you opt in, only the ending category is sent; no account name, player ID, save file, or device identifier is stored in the poll table. Supabase may process technical connection metadata, such as IP addresses, under its own privacy and security policies. Submitted votes are included in aggregate totals and cannot be removed individually. Read the Supabase privacy policy. Game progress, language, preferences and dialogue history are stored locally using browser storage. The optional offline cache stores the game’s public assets. Save files are exported or imported only when you choose those actions.

Local saves do not synchronize across devices, browsers or native applications. Clearing application or browser data, or uninstalling an app, can remove saves. Export a backup before uninstalling or clearing storage.

The web edition is hosted on GitHub Pages. Requests to GitHub’s hosting infrastructure may be logged by GitHub, including network and request metadata, under GitHub’s own privacy statement. This game loads its fonts, code, graphics and audio locally; it does not contact third-party asset CDNs at runtime. Native builds package the same assets locally.

No microphone, camera, location, contacts or advertising permissions are requested by the game. File import uses the system file picker to read only a selected save file. The game does not transmit the imported file.

For support or questions, use the project’s GitHub issue tracker. Anything posted there is governed by GitHub’s policy and may be public; avoid including private information.

سياسة الخصوصية

اللعبة لا تتطلب حسابًا ولا تعرض إعلانات، ولا تستخدم تتبعًا عامًا أو تقارير أعطال خارجية. يتوفر تصويت اختياري للنهاية: لا يُرسل اختيارك إلى Supabase إلا بعد تفعيل الموافقة صراحةً في شاشة النهاية والضغط على زر المشاركة. عند الموافقة، نرسل فئة النهاية فقط؛ ولا نخزن اسم حساب أو معرّف لاعب أو ملف الحفظ أو معرّف جهاز في جدول الإحصاءات. قد تعالج Supabase بيانات اتصال فنية مثل عنوان IP وفق سياساتها. تُدمج الأصوات في مجاميع ولا يمكن حذف صوت منفرد بعد تسجيله. راجعي سياسة خصوصية Supabase. أما التقدم والإعدادات وسجل تنويع الحوار فتبقى محفوظة محليًا؛ ونقل الحفظ يتم يدويًا بتصدير الملف واستيراده.

النسخة المنشورة مستضافة على GitHub Pages، وقد تحتفظ جهة الاستضافة ببيانات طلبات الشبكة وفقًا لسياستها. اللعبة نفسها لا تطلب الوصول للكاميرا أو الميكروفون أو الموقع أو جهات الاتصال. مسح بيانات المتصفح أو إزالة التطبيق قد يحذف الحفظ؛ صدّر نسخة أولًا.
